tools.name: get_servicenow_property
tools.description: Get the full explanation of one ServiceNow system property (sys_properties record) by its exact name, for example glide.sys.date_format, glide.sc.max_items or glide.authenticate.sso.saml2.nameid_policy. Returns a plain English summary, what the property does, type, default value, owning application

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_servicenow_properties" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_servicenow_property, search_servicenow_properties · Private data: get_servicenow_property, search_servicenow_properties, contact_maintainer · Public sink: search_servicenow_properties, contact_maintainer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_servicenow_property, search_servicenow_properties · Private data: get_servicenow_property, search_servicenow_properties, contact_maintainer · Public sink: search_servicenow_properties, contact_maintainer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
